intro: Trouble in the Deeps is a call for assistance sent from Stonetalon Mountains to the remote shores of Ashenvale. Tsunaman directs Horde adventurers to seek out the troll scholar Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, warning that dangerous forces lurk along the coast.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, friend. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Tsunaman sent you? Excellent. Then we have matters to discuss.
